scope: Georgia inland freshwater fishes, including migratory and introduced taxa

sources.purpose: Baseline names and family assignments; includes historical and provisional taxonomy
Sport fish coverage; Tallapoosa bass addition
Freshwater scope and extirpated taxa exclusions

curation_notes: Not an exhaustive or fully modernized taxonomic checklist; source entries can reflect historical records or uncommon introductions.
Species-group, provisional, hybrid and subspecies labels are explicitly marked; they are not all distinct species.
Includes all 21 previous labels with their existing stable IDs.
Split the atlas combined mosquitofish entry into Gambusia affinis and Gambusia holbrooki.
Added Micropterus tallapoosae from the DNR identification guide.
Corrected atlas Colosossoma to Colossoma and fireyblack shiner to fieryblack shiner.
Retained atlas names Micropterus calliurus and Micropterus pucpuggy, consistent with the 2025 UGA announcement.
Occurrence in this catalog does not establish native, legal, protected, or currently present status in any waterbody.
